fieldValues.title: SemanticOps is the root decision-making authority
fieldValues.decision_question: Which body holds final authority over the programme's work?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner on 2026-10-11, while unblocking general-lane work that no working group could claim (clerk#46, clerk#47); awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: SemanticOps is the top decision-making authority for everything within its domain. Other decision-making bodies with their own domains, such as muDemocracy, are separate and are not governed by it.
fieldValues.rationale: A clear root lets every other group's authority be traced to a delegation from it.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a second domain's body, such as muDemocracy, has its own queue and the boundary between the two must be drawn.
